name: How long does carpet installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does carpet installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of carpet installation depends on the size of the area, the type of carpet, and any necessary subfloor preparation. For an average-sized room, installation can often be completed in a single day. Larger projects or those requiring significant subfloor work may take longer. Our team will provide a more precise timeline after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carpet installation for an average room typically takes one day, but larger projects may require more time depending on the scope.
